About The Program

Empowering Youth for Nation Building

The National Service Scheme (NSS) is an Indian government-sponsored public service program conducted by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

At NIT Hamirpur, NSS provides students with hands-on experience in delivering community service. We believe that true education involves an understanding of the society we live in and finding solutions to real-world problems.

Community Service

Engaging in rural development, education, and health awareness campaigns.

Leadership Training

Developing organizational and leadership skills among college youth.

Our Mission

Core Objectives

The broad objectives of NSS are designed to enable students to understand the community in which they work, and to understand themselves in relation to their community.

Social Awareness

To understand the community in which they work and to understand themselves in relation to their community.

Problem Solving

Identify the needs and problems of the community and involve them in problem-solving.

Social Responsibility

Develop among themselves a sense of social and civic responsibility while utilizing their knowledge.

Democratic Attitude

Develop competence required for group-living and sharing of responsibilities in a democratic way.

Leadership Qualities

Acquire leadership qualities and democratic attitudes. Develop capacity to meet emergencies and natural disasters, and practice national integration and social harmony.
